description: A subscript that is an arithmetic expression other than an integer, a data-name or an index-name, each optionally followed by + or - an integer — a COBOL-2002 relaxation of a COBOL-85 restriction, QUOTED from ISO/IEC 1989:2002 Annex F.2 item 133: "Subscripting with arithmetic expressions. An arithmetic expression may now be used as a subscript, not just the forms data-name + integer and data-name - integer." COBOL-85 is the edition a 2002 Annex F.2 'formerly' statement describes: the owner's decision of 2026-10-31 (kb/Work PB4305) makes the F.2 statements the rule for the 85 edge, as D-SIGN2 (item 124) and PB3683 (item 123) did; GnuCOBOL -std=cobol85 accepts some of them as dialect leniency, which rule 1 places below the ISO text. Gated in ONE place, VersionConformancePass.ParseArm.VisitSubscriptPart, once per subscript (kb/Work PB4305; VCR row 7.47).
